## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- #120 Crawler: "The first time this game that this enters your board, add a Toxopid" fires once per game per player. "May be played from your GY for (1)" lets it be played from the graveyard at (1). "After this attacks, die" is `after_attack`. Its Death damages the last Unit it damaged.
- #121 Toxopid: (10). "Float reduces mana" is the existing "Float reduces cost". Each friendly Crawler that dies takes (1) off it for the rest of the game while it is in your hand or deck. "The first time this game that this enters your hand, add a Crawler" fires once per game per player. Its Cry summons the Legs as E7 reads it (base: three, anywhere; Radiant: four Radiant Legs, on your opponent's field). It is Indestructible while any Toxopid Leg is on the field.

- #126 Vela, #127 Corvus: line damage to a chosen enemy tile (E7). Corvus's is drawn as a laser.
- #123 Oct: its Aura is E6's per-turn damage pool, and the Radiant face's pool is 10.
